items.title_en: US drug agency approves breakthrough treatment for pancreatic cancer
items.summary_en: The US Food and Drug Administration has approved a new treatment for pancreatic cancer, marking a significant breakthrough in cancer therapy. The approval, announced on Wednesday, offers new hope for patients suffering from one of the deadliest forms of cancer.
items.title_zh: 美國FDA批准胰腺癌創新療法
items.summary_zh: 美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)批准了一項胰腺癌新療法，是癌症治療的重大突破。該批准於週三宣布，為患者帶來治療希望。

items.title_en: Meta's $18bn settlement may hasten reckoning for social media on child safety
items.summary_en: Meta has agreed to an $18 billion settlement with US authorities regarding child safety violations on its platforms. This landmark settlement represents the largest penalty ever imposed on a social media company for child protection issues.
items.title_zh: Meta同意18億美元和解，加速社媒兒童安全問責
items.summary_zh: Meta與美國當局達成18億美元和解協議，涉及其平臺上的兒童安全違規問題。這項標誌性的和解代表了對社交媒體公司兒童保護問題最大的罰款。

items.title_en: An Se-young wins second career badminton world title
items.summary_en: South Korean badminton star An Se-young captured her second World Championships title on Sunday, defeating her opponent in a thrilling final. The victory cements her status as one of the sport's elite players.
items.title_zh: 安賽楨獲得第二個羽毛球世界冠軍
items.summary_zh: 韓國羽毛球明星安賽楨於週日獲得第二個世界錦標賽冠軍，在決賽中擊敗對手。這場勝利確立了她作為羽毛球運動頂尖選手的地位。
